name: Fort Fisher
scope: Standing Fort Fisher earthworks on both sides of Fort Fisher Boulevard, including the restored land-face landscape and the Battle Acre Monument.
era: Standing site in 2025, after the three coastal earthwork restorations.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla-published original. The three-step brick pad, tall pale column, dark plaque and bronze eagle are visible. The photographer personally dedicated the photograph to the public domain.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The Qualla-published Battle Acre original was checked first. The 2025 USDA ortho tile is used only to place civic features and estimate horizontal dimensions from public-domain map control. Federal one-meter elevations guide the surviving earthworks.
